I've had the same issue with uninstalling and hiding updates which made testing Ancile very frustrating.

I managed to fix the issue by:

  1. Letting Ancile finish running (it took a few hours for me).
  2. Open a command prompt as an Administrator and run "sfc /scannow". this will scan your Windows files for errors.
  3. Reboot.
  4. Manually run Windows update and accept all recommended and optional updates (This took a few hours as well).
  5. Reboot.

After that the uninstalling updates portion finishes in about 15 minutes.

Hopefully this will fix things for you as well. I believe it has to do with missing an optional update(s) that MS put out to fix slow updating through the Windows Update process.
